description: Extract ALL JOINED Facebook groups from the current page (navigate to facebook.com/groups/joins/?ordering=viewer_added first) as a region-sorted index. Auto-scrolls the full virtualized joins list and dedupes by url in ONE call (defaults: scrolls:10, maxItems:1000 — override for very large/small lists). Each group {name, url, subtitle, member_count, region, lang, currency, source} is reconciled against the curated seed-queue memory first; groups not in it are classified from name+slug (language tokens: pt/tr/de/fr/es/pl/it/nl, and country aliases) into region + posting-currency, source:"name-heuristic"; the still-ambiguous ones land in region "Unknown" and under "unmatched". Spanish groups split into LatAm (USD) vs Spain (EUR). Returns { counts, byRegion: { UK:[...], US:[...], EU:[...], Brazil:[...], LatAm:[...], ... }, unmatched:[...] }. Pass region to filter to one bucket. Feed the whole JSON to fb_groups import {fromExtract} to populate/refresh the structured directory.

fields.description: Return only these fields; identity deduplication still uses the full items.

maxChars.description: Cap the complete grouped JSON response, preserving whole groups. Metadata must fit; unmatched duplicates are omitted first.

minItems.description: Stop scrolling once this many unique items are collected.

region.description: Optional case-insensitive filter: only return groups in this region bucket (UK, US, EU, Brazil, LatAm, Turkey, Australia, Canada, Unknown).

scrolls.description: Auto-scroll up to N times, extracting + deduping after each (default 0 = current view only). Stops early at minItems or end of feed.

seedQueueId.description: Memory id of the curated seed-queue (url | lang | currency) used to reconcile region/currency. Default: the built-in seed-queue memory id.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

timeoutMs.description: Total extraction deadline with browser V2 enabled (default 15000ms).

name: browser_extract_fb_groups
